budgets.trianglesPerPartNote: Measured structural-growth guard for ordinary modular parts, not a visible-quality ceiling. Raised max 15000->32000 for rock/gate parts; crossing it requires an explicit budgetClass rather than silent detail removal.
budgets.trianglesPerLandmarkNote: Measured LOD0 structural guard for authored hero places. The accepted Helios dense hub is 963696 LOD0 triangles with 40 draws, authored LOD1/LOD2, Meshopt, and KTX2; this separate class prevents ordinary parts inheriting the hero allowance.
